title: 빌려다가 읽기, 읽다가 멈추기
objective: By the end, you can use -아다가/-어다가 when you get something, take it to another place, and use it there. You can also use -다가, -았/었다가 and -다가도 to say that one action stopped or changed into another.
summary: Use -아다가/-어다가 to take something somewhere and do something with it there, and -다가 to switch from one action or state to another.

task.title: Choose and complete
task.line: Read each sentence, choose or make the right form, and write it in the blank or in brackets.

forms.when: Action verb whose last vowel is ㅏ or ㅗ, plus an object you move. Short form: -아다 (잡아다 놓다).
forms.means: Get or do something to an object in one place, take it to another place, then use it there.
forms.exampleMeaning: I caught fish at the sea, brought them back, and grilled and ate them.

forms.when: Action verb with any other last vowel, plus an object you move.
forms.means: Same meaning: take the object and use it somewhere else.
forms.exampleMeaning: I borrowed a book from the library and read it at home.

forms.means: Make or prepare something, then take it somewhere.
forms.example: 친구가 집에서 잡채를 해다가 파티에 가져왔어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: My friend made japchae at home and brought it to the party.

forms.when: Verb stem + -다가. The subject of the two actions must be the same.
forms.means: An action stops partway through and a different one starts.
forms.example: 숙제를 하다가 배가 고파서 라면을 끓였어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was doing my homework, got hungry, and made ramyeon.

forms.means: The first action was finished, then it was changed or undone.
forms.example: 창문을 열었다가 너무 시끄러워서 다시 닫았어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I opened the window, but it was too noisy, so I closed it again.

forms.means: Even while something is going on, it can suddenly change.
forms.example: 회사 일이 바쁘다가도 금요일 오후에는 조용해요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Work can be busy, but on Friday afternoons it gets quiet.

watchOut: 학교에 가다가 공부했어요 (X) → 학교에 가서 공부했어요 (O): To go somewhere and then do something there, use -아서/-어서. 가다가 means 'on the way (to school)', and -아다가/-어다가 needs an object that you carry.
코트를 다 입다가 더워서 벗었어요 (X) → 코트를 다 입었다가 더워서 벗었어요 (O): If you had the coat fully on before taking it off, the first action was finished. Use -었다가.
음식을 하다가 보내 주셨어요 (X) → 음식을 해다가 보내 주셨어요 (O): 하다 + -여다가 becomes 해다가. 하다가 means 'while making'.
제가 빵을 사다가 동생이 먹었어요 (X) → 제가 빵을 사다가 동생에게 줬어요 (O): With -어다가, the same person does both actions.
exercises: Fill in the blank with -아다가/-어다가 (받다): 우체국에서 소포를 ____ 사무실에서 열어 봤어요.
Fill in the blank with -여다가 (하다): 어머니가 반찬을 ____ 우리 집 냉장고에 넣어 주셨어요.
Choose the right form: ① 친구 집에 (가서 / 가다가) 같이 저녁을 먹었어요. ② 회사에 (가서 / 가다가) 길에서 옛날 친구를 만났어요.
Choose -다가 or -었다가: ① 에어컨을 (켜다가 / 켰다가) 추워서 금방 껐어요. ② 이메일을 (쓰다가 / 썼다가) 전화가 와서 잠깐 멈췄어요.
Fill in the blank with -다가도 (놀다): 우리 아이는 잘 ____ 엄마가 안 보이면 울어요.
Make one sentence with -아다가/-어다가: 회사 근처 빵집에서 샌드위치를 샀어요. 그리고 사무실에서 먹었어요.
answers: 빵집에서 샌드위치를 사다가 사무실에서 먹었어요. (회사 근처 빵집에서 샌드위치를 사다가 사무실에서 먹었어요.)
